subject: Re: MAP & Security gating — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA alignment
messages:
From: Alexsandra King <aking@verdantbank.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rios <trios@verdantbank.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro — MAP + security gates for pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Verdant Bank wants to formalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) to get a 3-week pilot live. Security is the blocker for our procurement team — they asked for a clear SOC 2 snapshot, SIG/CAIQ responses, and the DPA + retention commitments up front.

Can you share a MAP that shows:
- 2-week security evidence sprint (what you’ll provide and who owns reviews)
- DPA redline timeline and owner
- Data retention windows for hosted vs. private deployment options

We’d like to see dates we can commit to (we’re targeting a June 28 decision).

Thanks,
Alexsandra King
VP, Platform Risk — Verdant Bank

Attachment: none
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alexsandra King <aking@verdantbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tom Rios <trios@verdantbank.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — MAP + security gates for pilot

Hi Alexsandra / Tom,

Great to hear — we can absolutely structure a MAP that surfaces the security gates and ownership. I drafted a compact playbook and attached a SOC 2 heatmap and a trimmed SIG answers file for the initial pass. Summary below:

MAP summary (single-page):
1) Evidence sprint (Jun 24–Jul 2) — Redwood provides: SOC 2 Type II summary, control mappings, CAIQ/SIG condensed answers. Verdant reviews and flags gaps (2 reviewers). Owner: Stephanie Nguyen.
2) DPA redline & legal review (Jun 24–Jun 30) — Redwood legal provides clean DPA + proposed retention table. Verdant legal reviews; we expect a single redline round. Owner: Kimberly Park (contracts).
3) Data residency & retention options (Jun 24–Jun 28) — Hosted API (30/90/365 days retention options), Dedicated instances (customer-controlled retention), Private (on-prem) — we’ll list operational and evidence differences in the playbook. Owner: Ben Carter (solutions).
4) Decision window (target): Verdant to confirm pilot acceptance by Jun 28. If additional evidence required we'll run a short follow-up sprint (2 business days).

Attachments: soc2-gap-heatmap.pdf, sig-answers-compact.xlsx. I also attached a redline stub for the DPA (redline-DPA-v1.pdf) so legal can pre-seed comments.

Next step: I’ll schedule a 30-min sync this afternoon to walk through the MAP and assign reviewers. Does 3:30pm PT work?

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: soc2-gap-heatmap.pdf; sig-answers-compact.xlsx; redline-DPA-v1.pdf
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alexsandra King <aking@verdantbank.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — MAP + security gates for pilot — DPA & retention note

Thanks all — quick note from the contracts/ops side after looking at the DPA stub:

- Retention defaults: For hosted API our standard retention is 30 days for request/response metadata and 90 days for telemetry. We can offer a 365-day retention tier with a committed SLA for enterprise plans (impacts pricing).
- Dedicated/Private: Customer-configurable retention; we’ll provide an ops checklist for evidence collection.
- DPA redline: There’s one clause to flag — 'subprocessor list and notification window'. We suggest a 30-day notification and a 15-day remediation window for critical findings; Verdant may prefer a shorter notice, we are open to discuss.
- Evidence handoff: We propose a single shared Drive folder with read-only artifacts for SOC 2 and SIG items; we’ll record an evidence index that maps each control to the artifact.

I’ll update the redline (redline-DPA-v1 -> redline-DPA-v2) and circulate by EOD Jun 24. For the MAP, curious if Verdant can nominate 2 reviewers for the SIG items so we can batch responses and avoid ping-pong.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: none (redline to follow)
From: Tom Rios <trios@verdantbank.com>

Date: 2027-06-25T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — MAP + security gates for pilot

Hi team — quick follow-up after our internal intake:

- We can commit to the timeline if Redwood delivers the SOC 2 heatmap and SIG answers by EOD Jun 24 and the updated DPA redline by Jun 24 EOD. Our legal and platform-risk teams will review on Jun 25 and provide consolidated feedback the same day.
- Reviewers nominated: Alexsandra King (platform risk) and Maria Chen (Verdant legal, mchen@verdantbank.com) — I copied Maria on a separate thread.
- For retention: we prefer Hosted 90-day default (metadata/telemetry) during the pilot and will re-evaluate for production. Please include any cost delta for a 365-day tier in the pricing appendix.

If Redwood can get the requested artifacts into the shared Drive link in your playbook we’ll aim to sign off Jun 28.

Tom Rios
Director, Procurement — Verdant Bank
trios@verdantbank.com
